title: Zakat
summary: Works out zakat step by step in plain words: the nisab from your gold rate, the year from your first gold buy or a day you set, each cash account at its lowest over 354 days, your gold and metals, less bills due, and 2.5% of the total. Keeps a list of what you have given.
changes: Says step 1 before step 2 when there is no gold rate yet, and links to where the rate is set.
author: BrainDog
